newsitem.title: USA: Lexington 8.63 pct stake held by couple.
newsitem.headline: Lexington 8.63 pct stake held by couple.

text.p: Investors Jerome and Susan Davis said Thursday they held an 8.63 percent stake in Lexington B&L Financial Corp, or 109,200 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the couple, from Greenwich, Conn., said they bought the stake between May 21 and September 9 at prices ranging from $9.875 to $10.31 a share.
They said they acquired the stake for investment purposes.
